cannibalization_rules: HUB-01 owns agency, company, firm, services, solutions, system, and broad home-builder-marketing commercial variations.
ART-01 owns the diagnostic intent around a website not generating leads and website optimization; WEB-01 owns design, development, and service-comparison intent.
ART-02 owns home builder blog and editorial-ideas intent; CNT-01 owns the broader content-marketing operating system.
VIS-01 owns broad SEO and digital-visibility intent; LOCAL-01 owns local SEO; SEOCHK-01 owns the narrow on-page phrase/checklist intent.
STR-01 owns marketing plans, strategies, and tips; AUD-01 owns market segments and new-builder audience framing.
No asset is published until its reader job, primary query, canonical, and reciprocal internal links are documented.
Reject generic-agency and consumer-builder queries rather than bending the pillar toward the wrong audience.
